title: Persist the freight bond together with the accepted contract
message:
Persist the freight bond together with the accepted contract

Review of MR !15: accepting freight debited the bond in memory only,
while the contract and cargo went straight to the database, so a crash
before the next character save kept the freight and returned the
bond; and a failed manifest write was silent, so a later save could
keep the debit without the freight.

The contract claim and the manifest now commit in one transaction, and
the bond is debited only after that, then saved with
save_char_checked(). If the save fails, the gold is restored, the
contract reopened and the freight unloaded. vessel_db_save_cargo()
reports whether its writes succeeded.

title: Free what two S9 tests' fixtures leave behind
message:
Free what two S9 tests' fixtures leave behind

The sanitizer and memory-check jobs found two leaks. The tgo test's
rider entered a dynamic wilderness room, which scheduled the room's
occupancy check; the test now clears both rooms' events. The rename
fee test's christening wrote the bridge's name and description; the
test now frees them (the fixture's other strings live in the CuTest
arena).

title: Check the freight bond test's second acceptance
message:
Check the freight bond test's second acceptance

The second contractaccept's output was stored and never read, a dead
store clang-tidy reports; the test now checks that taking the job
again posts the bond again.

message:
Expect S9's wording in the tactical and rules gates

The tactical gate's wrapper required the shot target to read
'battered', though its own session accepts battered or crippled; since
a973e22d2 a holed hull reads crippled. The rules session expected the
bounty pay-off refusal's old wording, reworded in ab2701d0b to say the
admiralty office is ashore.

title: Record S9 chapter 15 notes
message: Record S9 chapter 15 notes

title: Discover only rooms a hull is big enough for
message:
Discover only rooms a hull is big enough for

A new raft could come with a mess hall, a medical bay, or crew
quarters: extra rooms were drawn from one pool for every class, and
each room's minimum hull size was never consulted. The draw now
re-rolls any room the class is too small for, so a raft's only extra
room is a hold.

title: Start the Blackwake derelict's clue chain with a plain search
message:
Start the Blackwake derelict's clue chain with a plain search

Nothing on the derelict's bridge hinted at 'searchashlog', the made-up
word that begins the chain, so a player could board her and never
find the first clue. The bridge trigger now answers 'search', the
command a player tries aboard a wreck ('searchashlog' still works).
The log and chart already name the next steps. The derelict gate now
begins with 'search'.

title: Send word to a summoned hull's owner when she makes port
message:
Send word to a summoned hull's owner when she makes port

A summons can take an hour, and only someone standing on the dock was
told the hull had arrived: her captain, gone about other business, was
never told. The harbor now sends word to her owner, if online
elsewhere, naming the port.

title: Find a contact by any word of her name
message:
Find a contact by any word of her name

'shiplock wraith' found nothing beside a hull named 'Ghost Fleet
Wraith 2-1': contacts matched only from the start of the name. Any
word of the name now matches too, nearest first, as goods do.

title: Say gunfire is forbidden in port, not from a berth
message:
Say gunfire is forbidden in port, not from a berth

A hull under way in the harbor was told 'The harbor watch forbids
gunfire from a berth', though she had cast off. The watch forbids it
anywhere in port; the refusal now says so.

title: Record S9 chapter 13 and 14 notes
message: Record S9 chapter 13 and 14 notes

title: Load and unload vehicles only at the surface
message:
Load and unload vehicles only at the surface

A magical hull hovering ten feet over a field loaded a cart from the
ground and set it down again, and a submerged hull could do the same:
neither load nor unload looked at her altitude or depth. Both now need
her at the surface, where there is ground beside her.

title: Carry the rider along when 'tgo' moves a land vehicle
message:
Carry the rider along when 'tgo' moves a land vehicle

'tgo' is the unified 'drive', but it moved the cart alone: the rider
stayed behind in the old room while 'Current position' reported the
new one. It now hands land vehicles to 'drive', which moves every
rider with the vehicle.

title: List the vehicles standing in a room when you look
message:
List the vehicles standing in a room when you look

Vehicles are not objects, so look never showed them: a player beside
a cart saw an empty field and had to guess at 'vmount'. Look now lists
each vehicle standing in the room after its objects; one loaded
aboard a hull stands in no room and is not listed.

title: Tell a boat steered off her waters where she keeps
message:
Tell a boat steered off her waters where she keeps

A riverboat steered onto the river bank was told 'Your boat cannot
handle these conditions! It's designed for coastal waters only.',
which reads like weather and says the river she is sailing is barred.
A boat sails rivers, marsh and shallow water, never the open ocean;
the refusal now says so.

title: Record S9 chapter 12 notes
message: Record S9 chapter 12 notes

title: Find goods by any word of their name; send admiralty business ashore
message:
Find goods by any word of their name; send admiralty business ashore

'cargobuy tomes 10' found nothing: goods matched only from the start
of their name ('forbidden tomes'). Any word of the name now matches.
Asking for a letter of marque or paying a bounty aboard a berthed hull
said only that it is done 'at a port's admiralty office'; the office
is ashore, and the refusals and help now say so.

title: Record S9 chapter 11 notes
message: Record S9 chapter 11 notes

title: Say 'You carry no price', not 'You carries'
message: Say 'You carry no price', not 'You carries'

title: Make turning on a groupmate's ship cost the group, as in person
message:
Make turning on a groupmate's ship cost the group, as in person

Grouped captains could fire on, board and claim each other's ships
and stay grouped, though a groupmate may work your guns and shares
your prizes, and attacking a groupmate in person costs the attacker
the group (fight.c). A recorded hostile engagement against a
groupmate's hull now does the same.

title: Record S9 chapters 9 and 10 notes so far
message: Record S9 chapters 9 and 10 notes so far

title: Let 'strongbox' find a raider's strongbox, not her key
message:
Let 'strongbox' find a raider's strongbox, not her key

The brass key also answered to 'strongbox', and the boarder carries
it, so 'unlock strongbox', 'open strongbox' and 'get all strongbox'
all found the key ('A brass strongbox key is not a container.'). The
key answers to key, brass and raider; the raider gate finds it with
'where raider-key'.

title: Say whether plunder found an empty hold or a full one
message:
Say whether plunder found an empty hold or a full one

A plunder that moved nothing said 'There is nothing worth taking, or
no room to take it.', leaving the boarder to guess. It now says the
prize's hold is empty, or that her own hull has no room.

title: Word a failed boarding of an empty hull without defenders
message:
Word a failed boarding of an empty hull without defenders

Boarding a hull with nobody aboard still told the boarder that 'the
defenders drive you back'. With no defender the hull alone resists:
'Your grappling lines fail to take hold.' or 'The hull rolls away
from you and the grappling lines part!'

title: Record the S9 landing and condition fixes
message: Record the S9 landing and condition fixes

title: Land people off a hull where the room lies, not where they last stood
message:
Land people off a hull where the room lies, not where they last stood

char_to_room() enters a wilderness room at the character's own
coordinates, which aboard a hull still hold wherever they last stood
ashore. Disembarking set them only after the move, and a failed
boarding crossing and a sinking set them not at all: a passenger
stepping off the ferry at the east dock landed back at the west
dock, and a boarder thrown into the sea at (-91, 77) came up at
(-66, 91). vessel_char_to_room() sets them first and serves every
place that puts people off a hull.

title: Record S9 chapter 8 notes
message: Record S9 chapter 8 notes

title: Call a holed hull crippled, not sound
message:
Call a holed hull crippled, not sound

Condition came from remaining structure alone, so a raider holed at
the bow and dead in the water still read 'sound' in contacts,
tactical, lookout, seastate and shipscan ('Condition: sound, holed on
1 side'). A holed side now makes her at least crippled.

title: Record S9 chapters 4, 5 and 7 and their fixes
message: Record S9 chapters 4, 5 and 7 and their fixes

title: Drop the article before Neutral Colors
message:
Drop the article before Neutral Colors

Fitting colors read 'fit Sea Wren with a Neutral Colors'.

title: Take a bond for freight, so abandoned freight is not free cargo
message:
Take a bond for freight, so abandoned freight is not free cargo

Accepting a contract loaded its freight for nothing and abandoning it
left the freight aboard as cargo, so taking and dropping the same job
loaded 75 salt a time to sell: in play, two rounds sold for 1,218
gold without leaving the dock. The payout already includes the
goods' worth; accepting now takes that worth as a bond (refused
without the gold), the board shows it, and the payout repays it with
the distance premium.

title: Trade and take freight at the port a hull lies in
message:
Trade and take freight at the port a hull lies in

A hull counted as in port by her coordinates, but market, cargo and
freight then keyed the port by her object's room. When that room is
not the port (a hull loaded into a transport's hold, or an object
room recycled by copyover) trade was recorded against an interior
room, and with no hull object the lookup would read past the world.
vessel_port_room() gives the one port room both checks use.

title: Offer freight only to ports that exist
message:
Offer freight only to ports that exist

The freight board drew its destinations from every room with market
rows, and a market once read aboard a hull left rows for room 70000,
a ship's interior: the Testing Dock offered '10 grain to an unknown
port'. Destinations are now only rooms that are ports.

title: Record S9 chapter 5 notes
message: Record S9 chapter 5 notes

title: Number ADDTOROUTE's help example as the game does
message:
Number ADDTOROUTE's help example as the game does

The help showed the first waypoint added 'at position 0'; the game
numbers route positions from 1, as autopilot status does.

title: Name the NPC pilot as a sentence starts, on one line
message:
Name the NPC pilot as a sentence starts, on one line

A pilot's arrivals, assignment and relief began with its short
description in lower case ('the harbor ferrymaster announces, ...'),
and the autopilot's ship-wide messages added their own line break to
the one send_to_ship() adds, leaving a blank line after each.

title: Let the autopilot arrive in a port before asking for its fee
message:
Let the autopilot arrive in a port before asking for its fee

A one-way route ending at a port berthed the hull on arrival and the
harbor charged her, and the next autopilot tick checked the unpaid
fee before the arrival: it paused 'before departure' at Waypoint 2
of 2 instead of completing the route. Arrival is now checked first;
the fee still holds her for any departure.

title: Record S9 chapter 4 notes
message: Record S9 chapter 4 notes

title: Name the port a dock fee is owed at
message:
Name the port a dock fee is owed at

shipstatus and dockfees told the owner the fee was due 'at port
1000389', a room number. Both now name the port (the Testing Dock).

title: Read lookout's vessels from the one contact list
message:
Read lookout's vessels from the one contact list

Lookout kept its own contact search, measuring from whole rooms while
contacts, tactical and gunnery measure from a hull's exact position,
so a ship stopped part-way through a room saw the same hull at 32.0
rooms bearing 23 in contacts and 31.4 bearing 22 in lookout. Lookout
now reads vessel_collect_contacts() like the others.

title: Tell the helm she is still casting off, not to order undock again
message:
Tell the helm she is still casting off, not to order undock again

An order given while the crew was already casting off was refused
with "order 'undock' to cast off first", as if undock had not been
ordered. The helm now hears how long casting off or weighing anchor
has left. The two copies of the refusal, for helm orders and
setsail, are one function.

title: Clear the ferry entry's old alternate keywords
message:
Clear the ferry entry's old alternate keywords

The rewritten 'boats' entry still carried SHIPS FERRY TRANSPORTSS as
alternate keywords, which help lookups and the help.hlp projection
both read. They are cleared, and the verifier checks it.

title: Give 'help ships' to the vessel help and rewrite the ferry entry
message:
Give 'help ships' to the vessel help and rewrite the ferry entry

The 2014 'boats' entry shared the SHIPS keyword with VESSELS and won
the tie, so 'help ships' showed 'enter <boatname>', a staff script
pointer, a stray backslash, and the misspelled keyword TRANSPORTSS.
SHIPS now belongs to VESSELS alone, and 'boats' (BOATS, FERRY,
FERRIES, PASSAGE) is a passenger's guide to public ships: boarding,
fares, the pilot's helm, and stepping off.

title: Record S9 chapters 1-3 and 6 and the defects fixed so far
message: Record S9 chapters 1-3 and 6 and the defects fixed so far

title: Keep a public hull's helm with her NPC pilot
message:
Keep a public hull's helm with her NPC pilot

Unowned hulls were open to anyone at the helm, so a passenger on the
bridge of a scheduled ferry or merchant could change her heading and
speed, drop anchor, reroute her, clear her schedule, or unassign her
pilot. An unowned hull with an NPC pilot now answers only to NPCs
and immortals, as the help's 'authorized NPC pilot' says; pilotless
unowned hulls stay open to anyone.

title: Compare the interior test's room numbers without a sign warning
message: Compare the interior test's room numbers without a sign warning

title: Tell a passenger to wait, not to stop the ship, before disembarking
message:
Tell a passenger to wait, not to stop the ship, before disembarking

Trying to step off a hull under way told everyone to 'Bring the
vessel to a stop first', which a ferry's passengers cannot do. Only
someone at the helm is told that now; anyone else is told to wait
until she stops.

title: Report the speed a piloted hull is answering, not a zero order
message:
Report the speed a piloted hull is answering, not a zero order

On a route with no speed order of her own a hull sails at all she can
make, but shipstatus and 'speed' printed the unset order: a pilot's
merchant under way at 9 read 'Speed: 9 / 9 (ordered 0)', as if she
were stopping. Both now show the speed the helm is converging on,
computed by the same function the helm tick uses.

title: Show lookout's vessels by their contact IDs
message:
Show lookout's vessels by their contact IDs

Lookout listed each vessel by its fleet slot ([13] Sea Wren) while
contacts, tactical, shipstatus and the gunnery commands all name her
by her two-letter contact ID ([AN]). Lookout now uses the contact ID,
its help says so, and the lookout gate checks it.

title: Lay out hull interiors so their exits agree with each other
message:
Lay out hull interiors so their exits agree with each other

Rooms of a larger hull hung off the bridge in direction order, which
took in up and down, and side passages used the first free direction
wherever the rooms lay: aboard a new ship the hold was both two rooms
north of the bridge and one east of it, and the minimap drew three
copies of the room you stood in. Past nine rooms the order wrapped and
overwrote the bridge's first exit, cutting a room off.

Each room now lies on one of eight level rays out from the bridge,
further out along the ray once the first eight are taken, and side
passages join only neighboring rooms in the direction between them.

title: Say that christening and customizing a hull need her owner aboard
message:
Say that christening and customizing a hull need her owner aboard

The purchase told a new owner to christen her, and SHIPCHRISTEN and
SHIPCUSTOMIZE help said nothing of boarding, so the first try on the
dock was refused. The purchase now says to board her, and the help
says both commands work aboard.

title: Rename a christened hull's interior with her
message:
Rename a christened hull's interior with her

Interior rooms take the hull's name from their templates when built,
so after 'shipchristen' her bridge kept the old name ('Starfall Survey
Ship's Bridge' aboard the Sea Wren) until a reboot rebuilt it.
Christening now re-renders the rooms from their templates.

title: Stop every hull glowing and humming
message:
Stop every hull glowing and humming

Hulls are instances of the generic object 70002, a builder's test
fixture flagged to glow and hum, so every ship in port read 'It has a
soft glowing aura! It emits a faint humming sound!'. Placing a hull
now drops those two flags, as it already sets the object's type.

title: Show a hull's builder details to staff only
message:
Show a hull's builder details to staff only

A player buying a hull was told the fleet slot and interior room
numbers meant for builders. Staff still see them; the buyer is told
the shipwrights hand over the named hull, moored in the room.

title: Keep shipbrowse's columns aligned for the Magical Vessel class
message:
Keep shipbrowse's columns aligned for the Magical Vessel class

The Class column was ten wide, so the fourteen-letter Magical Vessel
pushed the rest of its row out of line with the header.
